cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Outsmart the Room
cards.instruction: Turn every clue, deduction, and secret into a contest you must solve or control first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Don't open the delivery email. Let me deduce where our office biscuits went.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Reception signed for them. I'll tell everyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Wait. That's a clue, not a conclusion. I should announce the solution.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Too late. They're downstairs opening the box.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them nobody eats until I identify the contents. Finding a box doesn't mean they've solved the biscuits.

mechanism: A corrects each apparently solved biscuit clue into an incomplete verification so only A can pronounce the solution first.
confusable: Credit after discovery is D129; D139 must actively control the live puzzle's completion and each new clue.
comparison: A mundane office delivery becomes a contested investigation; the alternative is an explicit murder-mystery board contest.
seedUse: Use received box and biscuits eaten, making A's expert criteria move whenever others get ahead.
